title: Network Reconnaissance Investigation
story: The Black Falcon Bank SOC observed a short burst of unusual network activity against the public application server. The network also contains legitimate vulnerability scanning and routine administrative traffic. Determine whether a real reconnaissance attempt occurred and identify the responsible host.
objective: Analyze Suricata and Zeek telemetry, distinguish legitimate scanning from hostile reconnaissance, and reconstruct the suspicious activity.

questions.label: Identify the hostile reconnaissance source IP
Identify the authorized vulnerability scanner IP
Identify the ports probed by the hostile host
At what time did the hostile reconnaissance begin?
